name: v2.20.0
body: ## Announcement Read the official announcement: [Announcing GoReleaser v2.20](https://goreleaser.com/blog/goreleaser-v2.20/). ## Security GoReleaser v2.20.0 fixes an issue that could write inline publishing SSH private keys in cleartext to `dist/artifacts.json`. Upgrade to v2.20.0 and revoke and replace any keys exposed through shared or uploaded release metadata. See [GHSA-9422-8p9m-393x](https://github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser/security/advisories/GHSA-9422-8p9m-393x) for details. ## Changelog ### New Features * e1176e6189ddc4136161a2d00efa0ce0bd43b6a7: b8f79e0399c46895220e8479e24d599576b563a8: feat(ko): allow templates in platforms (#7233) (@mrueg and @caarlos0) * 2e260e4af35c00e0ad41e479c3830f9cfe858e36: feat(winget): update manifest schema to latest (1.28.0) (#7242) (@abemedia) * 4a1a1aecad78b7de77879e6b5e3809b578db000b: feat: allow skipping the changelog with --skip=changelog (#7234) (@mrueg and @caarlos0) ### Bug fixes * prerelease versions in generation (#7263) (@caarlos0) * 3d5c3a2efe1544b8f7d24a8c2ed10dab45b89a61: fix(tmpl): escape backslashes in mdv2escape (#7261) (@10kartik) *
